spans.s:
चेष्ट् चे॑ष्टति चे॑ष्ट˚ते pp. चेष्टित (q.v.) move the
limbs, stir, exert one's self, be active or busy, be engaged in (acc.);
act or behave towards (loc.);
 make, do, perform. C. चेष्टयति, ˚ते set
in motion, impel. — आ make, perform. परि wallow, roam about. वि
move the limbs, writhe, struggle, stir, be active or busy, act or behave
towards (loc.), effect, produce. सम् be restless, exert one's self,
act. — Cf. विचेष्टित.

चेष्टन n. चेष्टा f. the same;
 making, doing.
